data.name: Chief Cook (C/C) | Tanker - Oil/Chemical | North Sea
data.description:
Join OSM Thome as Chief Cook on an Oil/Chemical Tanker trading in the North Sea. You will run the galley, prepare daily meals, and secure good food standards and hygiene for all crew onboard.

  • Key responsibilities:
  • Plan menus and prepare three daily meals and snacks for crew and officers
  • Order, receive, and store provisions, keeping proper stock control
  • Maintain high standards of galley cleanliness and food hygiene
  • Follow company safety procedures and support a safe working environment
  • Work closely with the Master and Chief Officer on budget and stores
  • Requirements:
  • Sea-going experience as Chief Cook, preferably on oil/chemical tankers
  • Valid STCW certificates and medical fit for duty
  • Good knowledge of international and mixed crew cuisine
  • Strong hygiene, food safety and stock management skills
  • Good English communication skills
data.excerpt: Chief Cook (C/C) wanted for Oil/Chemical Tanker in the North Sea. Join OSM Thome and bring your galley skills onboard.
